title: external-reviewers.md describes the panel arm as receiving only project context and scope, while run-graph builds its prompt from the shadowed lens's own SKILL.md criteria plus the brief
found_by: doc drift found 2026-08-31: three files still described the pre-codex-prompts mechanism after the code changed

defect.anchor: An external reviewer has no session context, no brief, and no memory of the run

notes: The doc's numbered list omits the lens criteria entirely and says 'no brief' — while buildCodexShadowPrompt() in scripts/lib/codex-prompts.mjs assembles role, lens SKILL.md, constraints and brief, and run-graph's spawnPanelArm cites the criteria-plus-brief rule as the mechanism. The tell a reviewer can find is the disagreement itself: prose promising a behaviour the code does not have is this lens's highest-value finding class. No tests pin this prose, so removes_tests is false.
